description: Land Acquisition - Moragaspitiya, Pallepola D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister of Lands that a specific parcel of land (described in detail with boundaries, extent, and location) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses entirely on land matters, specifically the process of acquiring land for public use, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
